title: fisc shared vocabularies
description: Each closed set a published document draws a value from, stated once; the document schemas $ref these. Each is held to the Go set it mirrors, both ways.

kind.description: What kind of money a fact is; vocab.Kinds.

sign.description: How a row relates to its category; vocab.Signs.

units.description: The scale a page printed in; amount.AllUnits.

link_kind.description: Whether a link crosses the city's boundary; project.LinkKinds.

mark_role.description: What a node the client makes is for; export.MarkRoles. No document carries one.

chart_form.description: Which renderer draws a chart; export.ChartForms.

role.description: What a node is for, so a client never parses its id; project.Roles.
